decision.reason: At 3/4 or more non-degenerate capacities, the globally calibration-selected causal predictor closed under 50% of the Stage 0 oracle gap and left at least 10% of Stage 0 baseline cost between itself and the oracle.

rule.primary_basis: frozen ten-workload-suite aggregate at each non-degenerate capacity
rule.precedence: NO_GO if either NO_GO trigger holds; otherwise STRONG_GO if both STRONG_GO conditions hold; otherwise WEAK_GO.

primary_aggregation: At each capacity, sum raw costs across all ten frozen workload paths; no per-capacity or per-regime causal-method reselection.

prediction_quality.interpretation: Descriptive configuration-level association; configurations are not independent experiments.

bootstrap_interpretation: Intervals reweight saved per-sequence contributions conditional on each frozen stateful workload path; stateful cache trajectories are not regenerated under reordered bootstrap workloads.
